title: Giraffe in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='72' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='72' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='72' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='72' width='6' height='20' rx='2' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='43' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='56' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='66' y='88' width='6' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='64' r='3' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='71' r='3.5' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='64' r='3' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 66 Q82 62 80 54' stroke='#f2b23a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='53' r='3' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M38 66 L32 32 L44 30 L46 62 Z' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='56' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='44' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='35' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q38 40 48 34 L48 40 Q38 46 30 40 Z' fill='#e8443a'/>
  <path d='M46 36 L54 54 L49 56 L42 39 Z' fill='#ff6f61'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x='40' y='35' width='4' height='7' fill='#ffd166' transform='rotate(8 42 38)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <rect x='39' y='12' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <circle cx='31.5' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#c47a1c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='21' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2b23a' transform='rotate(-25 25 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='21' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f2b23a' transform='rotate(25 47 21)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='31.5' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='24' r='2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='35.6' cy='23.4' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.6' cy='23.4' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
